UPSC EPFO APFC Online Form 2026 – Extend – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the notification for the post of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) on the official website. This recruitment was released for 80 posts. The online application process for UPSC EPFO APFC Recruitment 2026 has started from 22 August 2026, and candidates can apply until 14 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details of UPSC EPFO APFC Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 August 2026
  • Last Date : 14 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 14 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Date Extend Notice
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
